Dear Colleague,

I am writing again about Ms Patricia Moore, aged 85, who is on your waiting list with osteoarthritis of the right knee. She has deteriorated since the original referral and I would be grateful if her care could be expedited.

Her Oxford Knee Score today is 31, compared with 39 at the last review. She can walk for about 39 minutes before needing to stop. Denies night pain. She walks without aids.

X-ray report (12/08/2026): "Moderate tricompartmental degenerative change with definite medial joint space loss."

She has had 3 weeks of physiotherapy in the community. There have been no steroid injections. Current analgesia: Paracetamol 1g QDS PRN. Weighed in clinic, BMI today 25.2.

She has been waiting 21 weeks so far. She would like to discuss knee replacement.

Kind regards,
Dr H. Robson
Stockton Quay Health Centre
